name: Police Chief
storyline: As the newly appointed police chief of a city plagued by crime, you must build an empire of justice from the ground up. Tasked by federal and local authorities, you must manage precinct budgets, handle escalating gang wars, suppress prison riots, and optimize interrogations to fully restore law and order to the streets.
summary: Police Chief is a casual mobile strategy and management game where players take control of a city's law enforcement forces. Players are tasked with expanding their precinct from a small station into a high-tech facility by building armories, managing inmates, training elite officers, and executing tactical operations.
